verdicts.reason: A: the headline-first stack reads well, but the NEW FLAVOR badge has been moved below the product. It is now a big pill stacked right above the CTA, so it looks like a second button and competes with it. The CTA is almost full-width and jammed against the side edges and the bottom. B: it keeps the original's order (badge, logo, product, headline, copy, CTA), but the badge is almost as big as the CTA and almost full-width, the stretched oval behind the top looks distorted, the subcopy runs nearly edge to edge, and about 100px at the bottom is dead space. B is slightly less confusing because its badge doesn't pose as a second button.
